answer: Random peer-review audit stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day expected earnings, locked 20 epochs. Each epoch a beacon audits 5 percent of agents, and three peers re-check their work, a mirror to each claim. A sparrow cannot fake a canyon of evidence: one honest identity passes, but 100 fakes must pay 100 bonds and pass 100 audits. Failed audits burn the bond. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards.
